data.exact_reserve_text: Positive movements on claims incurred net of reinsurance are driven predominately by increased reinsurance recoveries due to the Cavello Bay 50% quota share.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross opening claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2019 was GBP 1,331.49m. The movement in prior year provisions on a GROSS basis was an increase of GBP 14.053m (a modest gross strengthening, 1.06% of opening reserves). However on a net basis the syndicate recorded a large favourable movement driven by increased reinsurance recoveries arising from the Cavello Bay 50% quota share (and RITC activity), so the net picture is a large release. The gross strengthening is recorded in the technical reserves reconciliation (note 17) while narratives attribute the net improvement to quota share reinsurance arrangements and recoveries.
raw_causal_phrases: Positive movements on claims incurred net of reinsurance are driven predominately by increased reinsurance recoveries due to the Cavello Bay 50% quota share.
Effective 1 October 2019, the Syndicate entered into a 50% quota share agreement with Cavello Bay Reinsurance Limited (a subsidiary of Enstar Group Limited).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities) claims outstanding prior-year column. Prior-year movement (gross) taken from Note 17 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross GBP 14,053k). The syndicate also recorded a very large net release driven by increased reinsurance recoveries (Cavello Bay 50% quota share) and an RITC take-on of reserves (gross RITC taken on GBP 701,118k) which materially distorts net movements and the claims development triangle; users should be aware the net and gross pictures diverge substantially. The claims development triangle was legible but formatting and RITC entries complicate diagonal comparisons; triangle extraction is indicative and may contain transcription uncertainty.
